Kevin Hern

Republican candidate for United States Senator, Oklahoma · Open seat

U.S. Representative (Oklahoma's 1st District); businessman

Kevin Hern is a Republican businessman who has represented Oklahoma's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House since November 2018. On March 11, 2026, he announced a run for the open U.S. Senate seat left by Markwayne Mullin, who resigned to become Secretary of Homeland Security. He won the Republican primary on June 16, 2026, and is the Republican nominee in the November 3 general election.

Where Hern stands

Alignment with President Trump
Says he supports President Trump's agenda and pledged to be a 'loyal ally' to the president in the Senate.
Cost of living / economy
Says he wants to lower costs for Americans and move conservative policies through the Senate.
Health care
In his 2018 House campaign, said health care policy should make care more affordable and accessible without expanding the federal government, and argued the Affordable Care Act leads to higher costs and less access.

Background

  • U.S. Representative, Oklahoma's 1st Congressional District, 2018–present
  • Chair, House Republican Policy Committee, 2025–2026
  • Chair, Republican Study Committee, 2023–2025
  • Businessman and entrepreneur
  • Grew up on an Air Force base
  • Won 2026 Republican U.S. Senate primary in Oklahoma (June 16, 2026); endorsed by President Trump
